note: Promotion to the tracked schema (v0.92.0, prompt 3 tranche three). Each theme in this pack names exactly one row at one grade band, not five rows across the ladder, so "unbanded": true fills each row's empty description with its own complete sentence directly — no per-band suffix, since the row already names its own grade. track/code are not filled by this promotion (see tools/normalize_blocks.py apply_promotions): this pack's natural sub-groupings do not form the 50-block tracked shape. This promotion covers 109 of the pack's 111 rows; two rows (grade —, adult-route capstones) use a grade value outside the five standard bands and are out of scope until apply_promotions is extended to match on GRADE_LEVEL as well as BAND_LEVEL. Theme text and grouping are copied verbatim from data/blocks.csv; nothing else is touched.
